en.name: Barbecue sauce, bottled
en.summary: Bottled barbecue sauce is a shelf-stable commercial condiment built on tomato, vinegar, sugar, salt and smoke flavour. Unopened it keeps about 1 year from purchase in the cupboard. After opening, the fridge gives it about 4 months — and the label's advice to refrigerate is about quality, not safety.
en.pantry: About 1 year from purchase for an unopened bottle, kept cool and dry. The thing most people get wrong comes afterwards: a shelf-stable commercial barbecue sauce is safe stored at room temperature after opening, and the reason the label recommends the fridge is quality rather than safety. Refrigeration simply keeps a commercial sauce fresh for a longer period of time. What does happen in a warm cupboard is the sugar browning slowly, so the sauce darkens and the lift of the vinegar fades behind it. Cap it, keep it out of sunlight, and keep it off the shelf above the cooker.
en.fridge: About 4 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, which is where an opened bottle holds its colour, its sharpness and its smoke aroma longest. The particular hazard with this sauce is not the bottle but the brush. Barbecue sauce is the condiment most likely to be painted onto raw meat, and a brush that has touched a raw chop and then gone back into the jar has carried the raw meat with it. Pour out what you need into a bowl, discard whatever is left in that bowl, and never finish a cooked piece of meat with sauce that has already touched it raw. Wipe the neck and the inside of the cap too — dried sauce in the thread is where mould gets started. Homemade sauce, or a bottle thinned with stock or juice, is a different product and goes in the fridge from day one.
en.freezer: No freezer figure is given for bottled barbecue sauce, and there is little sense in freezing something that keeps for months in a fridge. If you have made a large batch of your own, freezing it in portions is entirely reasonable. For a commercial bottle the cupboard and the fridge already have it covered, and freezing can break the emulsion, leaving you whisking a separated sauce back together.
spoilage: Mould around the neck, the cap thread or on the surface of the sauce
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
A bottle that fizzes, hisses or squirts on opening after being stored
Colour gone dark brown and the texture separated into watery and thick layers
tips: Write the opening date on the label; months pass quickly on a condiment shelf.
Wipe the neck and cap after every pour.
Decant into a smaller bottle when it is nearly empty to cut down on air.
Never pour used marinade back into the bottle.

faq.q: Does barbecue sauce need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Not for safety — a shelf-stable commercial sauce is safe at room temperature after opening. Refrigeration keeps it fresher for longer, which is why the label suggests it.

faq.q: How long does barbecue sauce last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 4 months after opening at 4 °C or below.

faq.q: How long does an unopened bottle of barbecue sauce keep?
faq.a: About 1 year from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard.

faq.q: Can you reuse barbecue sauce that touched raw meat?
faq.a: Not without boiling it first. Sauce used as a marinade or brushed onto raw meat has to be boiled before it goes back on cooked food, and never returned to the bottle.

zh.name: 市售烤肉醬
zh.summary: 市售烤肉醬是以番茄、醋、糖、鹽和煙燻風味為基底的常溫調味料。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。開封後冷藏大約 4 個月——而瓶身建議冷藏，講的是品質而不是安全。
zh.pantry: 未開封的瓶子放陰涼乾燥處，從購買日起算大約 1 年。多數人搞錯的是接下來這件事：常溫販售的市售烤肉醬，開封後放室溫仍然是安全的，標籤建議冷藏的理由是品質而不是安全。冷藏只是讓市售醬料的新鮮度維持得更久。放在溫熱櫥櫃裡真正會發生的，是糖緩慢褐變，醬色愈來愈深，醋那股銳利感被壓在後面。請蓋緊、避免日曬，也不要放在爐台上方那一層。
zh.fridge: 4 °C 以下大約 4 個月，那是開封後最能維持顏色、酸香和煙燻氣味的地方。這瓶醬真正的風險不在瓶子而在刷子。烤肉醬是最常被刷到生肉上的調味料，而一支碰過生豬排的刷子再插回罐子，等於把生肉一起帶了進去。請把要用的量倒進小碗，碗裡剩下的丟掉；也絕對不要在起鍋前，用已經碰過生肉的醬再刷一次。瓶口和瓶蓋內側也要擦——螺紋上乾掉的醬垢正是發霉的起點。自製的醬，或被高湯、果汁稀釋過的醬，是不同的產品，第一天起就該冷藏。
zh.freezer: 市售烤肉醬沒有提供冷凍期限，而且一個冷藏就能放好幾個月的東西，冷凍意義不大。如果是自己做了一大鍋，分裝冷凍完全合理；市售瓶裝有櫥櫃和冰箱就夠了，而且冷凍可能讓醬體乳化崩解，解凍後你得再攪半天才拌得回去。
spoilage: 聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
放過一陣子後，開瓶時冒氣、嘶聲或噴出來
顏色轉成深褐，質地分離成水層和稠層
tips: 在標籤上寫開封日期；調味料架上的時間過得很快。
每次倒完都擦瓶口和瓶蓋。
快用完時換小瓶裝，減少瓶內空氣。
刷過生肉的醬絕對不要倒回瓶子裡。

faq.q: 烤肉醬開封後一定要冰嗎？
faq.a: 以安全來說不用——常溫販售的市售烤肉醬開封後放室溫仍然安全。冷藏是為了讓它更久保持新鮮，所以標籤才會建議。

faq.q: 烤肉醬放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 開封後在 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 4 個月。

faq.q: 未開封的烤肉醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。

faq.q: 刷過生肉的烤肉醬還能再用嗎？
faq.a: 不先煮沸就不行。當醃醬或刷過生肉的醬，必須煮沸後才能再刷到熟食上，而且絕對不能倒回瓶子。

faq.q: 中秋烤肉剩下的半瓶醬，放在陽台過一夜還能用嗎？
faq.a: 要看它有沒有被生肉碰過。只是倒出來用、瓶口沒沾到生肉的，放常溫仍然安全，這類醬本來就有足夠的酸、糖和鹽；但陽台又曬又熱，顏色和酸香掉得很快，所以請移回陰涼處、蓋緊，並把瓶口和蓋子內側擦乾淨——螺紋上那圈乾掉的醬垢就是發霉的起點。如果刷過生肉的刷子回頭沾進瓶子，或醬碗裡混進了醃肉的汁，那一瓶、那一碗就整個丟掉，煮沸過也不要倒回瓶子。
